main_text.l: lacrymantur: Ita etiam Philosophi, quod præ opinandi libidine, dogma condiderant, id usu, disputationibus, altercationibus, frequenti docentium inculcatione, flagitiosâ discentium credulitate, superstitiosâ vulgi, de Philosophorum placitis imaginatione, tandem vertunt in fatale & inconcussum Elementum: Sic vis adhibetur Veritati: Hac deinde ligamur, & per errores trahimur catenâ, cujus omnes hamos & annulos, humana procudit stoliditas & vecordia. At tibi repentè! (de via decedite) Amor-sapientiæ depellit Mangonem ab ansa istius,

page.notes: Show-through from the facing page appears at the right edge and is not transcribed. The catchword "quæ" is printed at the lower right. The running head is set in small capitals as "ARNOLDI GEULINCX,".
